title: Laird Superfood, Inc. 8-K Filing — Acquisition of Terrasoul Superfoods
summary: Laird Superfood, Inc. completed the acquisition of Terrasoul Superfoods, LLC for $48 million in cash plus up to $5 million in earnout consideration, funded by a concurrent $60 million preferred stock issuance to Gateway Superfood funds. This is a routine corporate M&A filing for a small-cap food company on NYSE American; it contains no market structure or macro catalyst content.
key_points: Laird Superfood acquired 100% of Terrasoul Superfoods equity for $48M cash plus potential $5M earnout tied to 2026 Contribution Margin thresholds
The acquisition was funded by issuing 60,000 shares of Series A Preferred Stock at $1,000 per share ($60M total) to Gateway Superfood NSSIII/NSSIV Investment entities
The company entered restrictive covenant agreements with seller parties (Dennis Botts, Amy Botts, Jerry Collins, Mark Miller) for periods of 3-5 years post-closing
Laird Superfood is listed on NYSE American under ticker LSF; Terrasoul is a small organic/superfoods brand
Filing date of April 21, 2026 places this as a recent corporate event
